motion.name: scrub-linear
motion.purpose: Default for every scroll-tied graphic: progress maps 1:1 to scroll and reverses on scroll up.

motion.name: scrub-smoothed

motion.name: smooth-scroll

motion.name: opening-build
motion.value: pin intro from top+=65 for +=85%; blocks scattered (rotation to 90deg, scale .72) to 3x3, 0.04 stagger, .2 hold

motion.name: heading-slide
motion.value: xPercent 40 to 0 (12 to -8 under 760px) over the band's full pass; rule scaleX 0 to 1 from top 80% to bottom 40%

motion.name: shot-unmask
motion.value: clip-path inset(16% 22% 16% 0% round 10px) to inset(0 round 10px), img scale 1.22 to 1, top 98% to top 65%

motion.name: column-parallax
motion.value: every second project y 90px to -30px across its pass; desktop only
motion.purpose: Right gallery column drifts against the left.

motion.name: row-rule
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1 from origin left, top 92% to top 60%

motion.name: timeline-draw
motion.value: scaleY 0 to 1 from top, top 75% to bottom 55%; marker turns cobalt (.25s) when progress passes it

motion.name: stack-gather
motion.value: x up to +/-160px, y 40-100px, rotation up to 14deg, opacity 0 to rest; top 95% to top 55%

motion.name: contact-takeover
motion.value: pin contact for +=80%; 240px block scale .2 at -45deg to cover viewport diagonal at 0deg; content appears at .95; .35 hold
motion.purpose: Cobalt block grows to become the contact page.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or no GSAP: final states only, no pin, no scrub, all timeline markers on

narrative.overview:
A plain off-white page where the only graphics are flat square blocks and straight lines, and every one of them is tied to the scroll position. Nothing moves on its own: scroll down and the pieces assemble, scroll up and they come apart again. Blocks carry the idea of building things without decoration; the page itself stays simple, a single grotesk in ink and gray on a quiet ground.

Density is low and the reading order is linear: a large name with nine blocks, a full-bleed sliding heading over a two-up screenshot gallery, a ruled list, a narrow about column with a drawn timeline and a stack of chips, and a contact page that a cobalt block grows to fill. Cobalt is the single accent and it belongs to the moving graphics and the contact field; everything else is ink, gray and hairlines.

The system rejects ambient motion, 3D scenes, gradients, shadows, card containers and fade-up-on-every-section entrances. Every animation has a resting final state that is the whole design, which is what reduced-motion users and no-script visitors receive.
keyCharacteristics: Flat off-white ground, ink type, one cobalt accent.
Square blocks (4px radius) and 2px ink lines as the only graphic vocabulary.
All motion scrubbed to scroll with GSAP ScrollTrigger, reversible, never autoplaying.
No shadows, no gradients, no cards.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only hue. It appears on graphics that move, on interaction feedback, and on the contact field. It never fills a static section background, a heading, or body text.

rules.name: The No-Ramp Rule
rules.body: There are no tints or shades of any token in use. If something needs to be quieter, it moves from ink to gray or to the hairline, not to a new lightness.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400, 500 and 600 exist. 600 is for headings and the email; 500 for the tagline, buttons, links in meta rows and primary chips; 400 for everything else.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Every h1 to h3 is semibold with at least -0.02em tracking and `text-wrap: balance`.

rules.name: The Flat Block Rule
rules.body: Blocks, buttons, chips and shots never cast a shadow and never carry a gradient. A block is a solid fill with a 4px corner.

dos: Do scrub every animation to scroll position (`scrub: true` or `.6`, `ease: 'none'`) so it runs backwards on scroll up.
Do give every animated element a final state that is the complete design, and ship that state alone under `prefers-reduced-motion` or when GSAP fails to load: no pins, no scrub, timeline markers on.
Do build graphics from solid square blocks (4px corner) and 2px ink lines only.
Do keep cobalt (#2340ff) to moving graphics, interaction feedback and the contact field.
Do use Host Grotesk alone at 400, 500 and 600, with negative tracking on headings.
Do let project content sit directly on the ground under its screenshot, separated by space, not containers.
donts: Don't add ambient or autoplaying motion: no loops, idle drift, marquees or time-based entrances.
Don't add 3D scenes, WebGL backgrounds or particle fields.
Don't use shadows or gradients on any surface.
Don't wrap projects or sections in cards.
Don't fade-up every section on entry; motion belongs to the graphics, not the copy.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or tints of the existing tokens.
